question: Should OpenClaw adopt YAML-frontmatter `CLAW.md` as the canonical exported Claw manifest while retaining JSON as a readable compatibility format?
rationale: Code review can validate the implementation, but choosing the canonical authoring and export representation creates a durable package contract and must align with the open RFC and stacked lifecycle direction.

options.title: Approve CLAW.md canonical output
options.body: Accept the demonstrated Markdown representation and land this slice only after the prerequisite lifecycle PRs settle.

options.title: Keep JSON canonical
options.body: Retain JSON export as the canonical representation and narrow this branch to optional `CLAW.md` input support.

options.title: Pause for the broader specification
options.body: Keep the slice unlanded until the harness-agnostic Claws specification resolves the canonical representation.

recommendation.title: Approve CLAW.md canonical output
recommendation.body: Accept the demonstrated Markdown representation and land this slice only after the prerequisite lifecycle PRs settle.
